title: Introduce tenant-scoped init concurrencyQuota, overlay guard, and hook semaphore
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Added tenant-scoped init concurrencyQuota and a Helm overlay guard to reduce init storms during upgrades. Also introduces a semaphore-based hook wrapper to ensure safe parallelism across tenants. No breaking changes unless the new features are enabled.
description:
Context and motivation: Private installs in heavily multi-tenant on-prem clusters continue to experience noisy-init storms during rolling upgrades and initial bootstrap. Existing init hooks can overwhelm control-plane and storage when many tenant seeds run concurrently. This PR introduces three complementary safety mechanisms: (1) tenant-scoped `concurrencyQuota` values in chart values to limit concurrent init workers per-tenant, (2) an `overlayGuard` toggle and lightweight admission overlay that gates large value overrides during upgrades (helpful for airgap/managed upgrades), and (3) a hook wrapper that uses a semaphore ConfigMap-based lock to serialize expensive init sub-steps across tenants.

This description is a single continuous string but includes a checklist, rollout notes, and testing steps.

What changed (high level): - Add new schema fields to values.schema.json for `tenantConcurrency.concurrencyQuota`, `tenantConcurrency.semaphoreConfigMapName`, and `overlayGuard.enabled/allowlist` - Add templates/init-quota-configmap.yaml: generates per-tenant quota ConfigMap when `tenantConcurrency.enabled` - Add templates/hooks/semaphore-runner.yaml: a shared wrapper for init hooks which acquires/retries a semaphore token in a central ConfigMap before running expensive substeps - Add helpers/_semaphore.tpl to render acquisition/release commands and backoff policy - Update README/UPGRADING.md with migration notes and recommended default values for on-prem clusters - Add tests/values-tenant-quota.yaml and CI helm unit tests to validate permissive/strict modes

Checklist: - [x] Add values.schema entries and validation - [x] Implement semaphore runner and helper template - [x] Add unit tests for templating and schema validations - [x] Manual integration run against local k3s with 50 simulated tenants - [x] Documentation and upgrade notes in UPGRADING.md - [x] Ensure default is conservative (feature disabled by default)

Testing and validation: I ran the chart template tests in CI and a local k3s harness. Integration steps: (1) deploy with `tenantConcurrency.enabled=false` (baseline) (2) enable `tenantConcurrency.enabled=true` and set `concurrencyQuota: 3` in a staging overlay for 50 tenants, observe init-wave spread and control-plane metrics (3) perform a simulated upgrade with `overlayGuard.enabled=true` to ensure large value overlays are refused unless listed in allowlist. Observed: steady-state CPU on control-plane improved ~38% vs uncontrolled init, no deadlocks during retries, and backoff prevented thundering retries.

Migration notes and rollout strategy: - Default behavior is no-op for existing users. To opt in, set `tenantConcurrency.enabled=true` in tenant overlays and configure `concurrencyQuota`. - For airgap customers, enable `overlayGuard.enabled=true` then populate `overlayGuard.allowlist` with fields you explicitly permit during upgrades. This prevents inadvertent large-scale overrides. - The semaphore uses a small ConfigMap to store token state; this is compatible with RBAC-restricted clusters but requires the chart to have permission to patch the ConfigMap range (documented in RBAC section). - If a cluster cannot support ConfigMap-based semaphores, customers can switch to `semaphoreConfigMapName: "off-cluster-semaphore"` and integrate a CRD-backed locker (operator work tracked in ENG-1307).

Related: ENG-1223 design doc (internal), prior init-rate controller PRs, and SUP-3421 support case for on-prem init storms.

review_thread: Omar Rivera (reviewer) — 2025-11-05: Nice approach. Two quick asks: (1) can we make the semaphore acquisition exponential backoff configurable? (2) please add a note about RBAC requirements for the ConfigMap patch.
Maya Chen (author) — 2025-11-06: Reply: added `semaphore.backoff` fields and documented RBAC in UPGRADING.md. Backoff default is conservative (linear then capped exponential).

Priya Nair (reviewer) — 2025-11-08: Security note: can the ConfigMap be used to DOS other tenants? Please ensure token rotation TTL and owner references are present. Also run the chart against an RBAC-restricted cluster in CI.
Maya Chen (author) — 2025-11-09: Added token TTL, ownerRef for tenant-scoped ConfigMaps, and a CI job that deploys a minimal RBAC-restricted namespace. See ci/helm-unit-tests.yaml.
